thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU pool saturation detected in us-west2. Autoscaler pending due to region quota limits. Queue length for /v1/generate up 420% in last 5m. Severity: P1. Paging on-call.
Jade: got it, picking this up — oncall here. reading dashboard now.
Maria: seeing a surge of pending pods in us-west2-autoscaler (podsPending=48). kube events show 'FailedCreate: QuotaExceeded: Insufficient accelerators'. Confirmed GCP GPU quota hit for project-redwood-prod in us-west2.
Sam: infra confirms nvidia-t4-standard quota at 100% in us-west2. Quota request started but GCP ETA likely hours. No auto-failover configured for this workload by default.
Jade: customer impact? Ellen, any inbound support alerts?
Ellen: support stack shows increased 429s starting ~10m ago. ~3% of requests currently get 429; 95th latency up ~800ms. A few PLG customers flagged degraded responses. No full SLO breach yet but trending.
Jade: immediate plan: (1) arrest queue growth, (2) reduce user-facing errors, (3) route non-enterprise traffic away from us-west2. Options: throttle, reduce local concurrency, enable model-fallback to lighter model, or override routing for PLG.
Sam: can push routing override to prefer eu-west1 for PLG/new sessions. Enterprise sessions pinned by token routing can't be moved automatically. Preparing override now.
Maria: also can patch serve-config to fallback to 'gpt-small-quantized' for /v1/generate which reduces GPU footprint per replica. That should reduce pending pods.
Jade: proceed. Sam: override non-enterprise routes. Maria: apply fallback and lower per-pod GPU allocation or switch instance SKU.
Sam: applying routing override: ```curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routing/overrides" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN" -d '{"scope":"plg","prefer_region":"eu-west1","reason":"us-west2 gpu quota hit"}'``` — should be live ~30s.
ops-bot: ALERT: routing override applied by sam.infra at 1765004400. Rolling updates to edge proxies.
Maria: patching model fallback: ```PATCH /models/serve-config
{
  "selector": "/v1/generate",
  "fallback_model": "gpt-small-quantized",
  "enable_prefix_cache": true
}``` Deploying — will lower memory/GPU requirements.
Jade: also reduce max concurrency for local workers to prevent queue amplification. Maria, patch HPA.
Maria: patched HPA: ```kubectl -n inference patch hpa autoscaler-us-west2 -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":10}}'``` After fallback + routing shift, pending pods dropped from 48 -> 12.
Ellen: support update: error rate down to ~1.1%, latency improving. Notifying affected customers: "Temporary routing + lightweight model deployed — performance improving. We'll follow up with an ETA for capacity restoration." :thumbsup:
Jade: solid. Next: open GCP quota case and ask for expedited bump. Sam, can you open a critical support case with usage graphs?
Sam: opened GCP case INC-760234 at 1765004560. Included accelerator SKU, quota graphs, and production impact. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/INC-760234
Sam: internal fallback runbook: if quota not increased within 2h, migrate non-enterprise PLG traffic to eu-west1 permanently and schedule capacity commit.
Maria: autoscaler logs: ```E0524 12:20:10 scaler.go:143] scale attempt failed: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = region quota exceeded: accelerators.googleapis.com/nvidia-t4  (project:project-redwood-prod)```
Jade: any spare capacity we can tap from Dedicated pools in other regions/accounts?
Sam: dedicated pool in eu-west1 has spare GPUs. We can burst a subset of traffic there but need approval for cross-account routing for enterprise tenants. I'll coordinate with sales/SDR for approvals.
Ellen: informing enterprise contacts that we're shifting some traffic; collecting any compliance concerns (IP/region).
Jade: action items: Sam — routing override applied, GCP case opened, coordinate Dedicated burst. Maria — fallback model + autoscaler patch done, keep monitoring. Ellen — customer comms. I'll remain on until green.
incident-bot: NOTE: Pager suppressed for reroutes after 1765004700. Continue updates in this thread.
Maria: metrics snapshot (5m): queued requests 120 (was 650), 429s 0.7%, 95th latency +250ms. Improvements holding.
Sam: GCP case update: assigned engineer requested per-zone sku usage. They may grant temporary quota but require org justification. ETA TBD.
Jade: contingency if quota denied/delayed: (a) shift 100% PLG traffic to eu-west1, (b) enable throttling for non-critical endpoints, (c) schedule controlled rollout of dedicated capacity in affected region.
Ellen: customers asked about SLA credits; forwarding to sales for follow-up.
Maria: dispatching graceful queue-drain job to retry long-running jobs in eu-west1: queued-drain.sh started.
Sam: triggering cache warmers in eu-west1 to reduce cold-start latency for the redirected traffic.
Jade: log all config diffs + timestamps for postmortem. Tagging @maria.sre and @sam.infra in the incident doc.
Maria: will record timeline and attach config diffs to incident doc.
Jade: closing immediate mitigation — queue stable and errors decreasing. Keeping incident open until GCP confirms quota bump or we schedule a migration. Thanks all.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, impact=partial, next-update-in=30m.
Maria: last check 1765005123: queued 80, 429s 0.5%, 95th +180ms. Holding. Will update on any changes.
Jade: handing off to overnight oncall (Leo) at 1765005123. Leo, monitor eu-west1 routing, watch for enterprise compliance flags, escalate if queued >200 or 429s >2%. I'm offline.
Leo: acknowledged, taking handoff. :eyes:
